Some parts may still be available, so inquire directly about purchase if you wish. Standard Finish Tube-like saturation, a fully active 3-band EQ, 3 different gain modes, enormous 32 Volt headroom and a unique design have earned the 112+ its proper place among classic dirt pedals. A low noise floor and the ability to clean up well certainly don’t hurt either. Ltd. Ed. Black Finish The 112+ sounds great on its own but lives to compliment and enhance the sounds you've already perfected. Stack it with other drives, fuzzes and distortions, or into the drive channel of your amp, and enhance your sound with even more warmth, push, grit and power. Hand-Stamped/Polished A 3-band active EQ gives you boost- and cut-control over the Bass, Mid, and Treble ranges, letting you sculpt your drive sound to be exactly the way you like it. Gutshot of a 2021 112+ A unique clipping scheme (based on one found in a line of early 90's solid state amplifiers for which the pedal is named) causes your signal to hit multiple clipping thresholds before having the sharp edges smoothed out. The resulting rounded waveform is strikingly similar to the response characteristic of a valve amplifier driven into heavy overdrive when the gain is turned up. Functional Diagram of final 112+ revision - attenuator stage not present on pre-2021 models (and you can tell because they’re LOUD).
